title: NFL Cuts Tracker 2026: Live Roster News, Updates, Notable Cuts for All 32 Teams
dek: All 32 NFL teams must reduce their rosters from 90 players to 53 by 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, August 30, 2026. Teams can retain up to 17 practice squad members, including one international player. The deadline marks the shift from the offseason to regular-season roster composition.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: All 32 NFL teams must trim their rosters to exactly 53 players by 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
bottom_line: All 32 NFL teams face the 6 p.m. ET deadline on Sunday, August 30 to finalize their 53-man rosters. Check team announcements and cut tracker updates throughout the day to track which rosters took shape and which teams made notable roster shifts.
body:
Every NFL team must reduce its roster to exactly 53 players by 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, August 30, 2026, according to Sporting News. The deadline marks the annual transition from the 90-man offseason roster to the regular-season eligibility list.
Beyond the 53-man active roster, each team can carry up to 17 practice squad members, with one required to be an international player, per Sporting News. This structure allows franchises to maintain depth while adhering to the strict regular-season cap.
Historically, the cut-down deadline has fallen on the Tuesday following the preseason, though this year's timing places the deadline on Sunday.
Roster decisions on cutdown day affect not only playoff ambitions but also individual player livelihoods, as teams balance salary cap constraints, competitive needs, and draft investment. Which players fail to make 53-man rosters and which unexpected names stick often reveal early competitive imbalances or roster miscalculations across the league.
